description: Get the ready-to-use AI prompts attached to one principle (prompts to apply, audit or refactor an interface against it). With UXUI_API_KEY set (pro mode) the prompt texts come back in `prompts`; without it the prompts belong to the paid Principles Library and the tool returns the count and the URL of the guide. Call get_principle first if you only need the summary.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

name: get_principle_prompts
title: Get the AI prompts of a principle
